name: Intervention A: Advanced AI/ML & Deep Learning Specialization
description: Intensive hands-on curriculum covering statistical learning, scikit-learn predictive pipelines, PyTorch deep neural networks, and modern NLP workflows.
rationale: Empirical labor market analysis shows 78% of ML Engineer and 43% of Data Scientist job postings require machine learning competence. Elevating ML capability unlocks high-tier predictive modeling roles.

name: Intervention B: Analytics Translation & Executive Storytelling
description: Executive dashboard architecture (Power BI / Tableau), KPI synthesis, business problem translation, and data storytelling for decision-makers.
rationale: Empirical evidence from the Junior Data Scientist (JDS) cohort proves dashboard and storytelling capability has the highest observed correlation (r=0.554, beta=1.186) with performance-based salary hikes.

name: Intervention C: Production Data Engineering & Cloud MLOps
description: Distributed data computing (Spark, Hadoop, Hive), scalable data warehouse modeling, Docker containerization, cloud data services, and MLOps deployment pipelines.
rationale: Data Engineering roles command an average salary of 11.8L and Senior Data Engineer 19.0L, representing over 8,000 market vacancies. Overcoming the Spark/Cloud barrier opens lucrative engineering career tracks.
